title: Comparative Effects of Minodronate and Alendronate on Low Back Pain in Postmenopausal Osteoporosis and Age Influence: A Head-to-Head, Randomized Clinical Trial
time_scope: VAS baseline to week 12; BMD baseline to week 24.
excluded: Age-stratified analyses, other VAS visits and bone-turnover markers
Registry records whose population and interventions do not match this osteoporosis trial
population_or_material: Postmenopausal participants with osteoporosis-related low back pain in the intention-to-treat (ITT) efficacy population only, retaining the source-reported endpoint-specific analysis denominators.
requested_items: For week-12 VAS, extract the mean reductions and 95% CIs stated in the main Results VAS paragraph and the abstract-reported endpoint between-group P value. Use the main Results week-12 time label; do not add the differently labelled serial visits from Table S2.

For lumbar-spine and total-hip BMD, use only the W24 column of Supplementary Table S3: extract each treatment arm's mean percentage change, its SD, and the between-group P value. Table S3 time-specific cells take precedence over BMD prose, abstract summaries and figures. Do not import abstract-only BMD CIs or repeat W12 values as W24.
Keep each between-group P value in a separate result row because no between-group difference estimate is requested.
case_specific_rules: For requested VAS reductions use the main Results week-12 report, with the requested abstract endpoint P. Recover units from the adopted source; retain conflicting presentations in separate review records.
For BMD use only Supplementary Table S3 W24 cells and their own SD/P; exclude W12 and abstract-only CI alternatives. Apply the shared denominator rules.
